researchCase.why: Western Michigan is 5-3 against Bowling Green at 2-6. I only need the Broncos by four at home, well below the main spread.
researchCase.risk: Bowling Green has forced a fumble in three straight games and its quarterback has completed over 70% in three straight. WMU just allowed 45 at Toledo.
researchCase.availability: Broc Lowry and Jalen Buckley played in the latest official WMU recap. Current opponent preview checked; this is not an all-clear injury guarantee.

sources.fact: Current game preview lists WMU 5-3 and Bowling Green 2-6; Kastantin has three straight games over 70% completions and the defense three straight with a forced fumble.
Western Michigan lost 45-38 at Toledo and returns home for Bowling Green. Lowry threw a late interception.

researchCase.why: Illinois just held Oregon to 10 points. I am taking Illinois +7.5 against Maryland, so a touchdown loss still covers.
researchCase.risk: Maryland comes off a bye with a new interim coach. Illinois has quarterback uncertainty: the team preview lists Houser injured and freshman Clayton coming off his first start.
researchCase.availability: Official Illinois preview reports Houser broken hand and Clayton replacement. A newer gameday report lists Houser questionable and traveling; do not assume a healthy returning starter or use his season passing averages.

sources.fact: Illinois beat Oregon 21-10; the preview identifies the Houser hand injury and Clayton replacement. Maryland is coming off a bye under interim coach Abdul-Rahim.
Maryland hosts Illinois at noon and makes its first appearance under interim coach Aazaar Abdul-Rahim.
Gameday reporting lists Houser questionable on Friday and traveling, a status update that keeps quarterback uncertainty explicit.
